openidconnect 4.0.1 retains p256/p384 0.13 for public ID Token verification. Native desktop/mobile OIDC only verifies issuer signatures; no signing or ECDH uses this dependency. Wallet signing and ECDH use the separately pinned p256 0.14 with crypto-bigint 0.7.6. No compatible upstream 0.5 patch exists. Re-review before any legacy private-key use; migrate when upstream permits. See docs/crypto-bigint-advisory-review.md.

The isolated jsonwebtoken 11.1.0 RustCrypto probe exports only public-key signature verification and imports no signing API. Its upstream p256/p384 0.13 constraints cannot resolve crypto-bigint 0.7.6. No product private keys enter this graph. Remove when an upstream-compatible patch is available; re-review before private-key operations. See docs/crypto-bigint-advisory-review.md.

The isolated probe compiles the actual native VP HTTP adapter, using openidconnect 4.0.1 only for its reqwest HTTP re-export. Its transitive p256/p384 0.13 is not used for private-key operations; no product secret integer enters crypto-bigint 0.5.5. Remove when upstream permits a patched version; re-review before extending this scope. See docs/crypto-bigint-advisory-review.md.
